idea-plugin.name: JOL Memory Analyser
idea-plugin.description: Runs the JOL-based memory layout scanner on your project or the current Java file. Requires the jol-memory-analyser-*-standalone.jar (build locally or resolve from Maven Central). See plugin README for setup.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.3: Missing standalone JAR / setup instructions appear in the tool window (not a popup). Maven local repo resolution uses IntelliJ's effective repository path.
1.0.2: Scanner output streams to the JOL Memory Analyser tool window (bottom) instead of a modal dialog.
1.0.1: Support IntelliJ 2023.2 (build 232+) in addition to newer releases.
1.0.0: Scan project / Scan current Java file via context menu and Tools menu.

action.description: Run layout scan for the current Java file (uses compiled classes under target/classes).

action.description: Scan all classes under target/classes of the open project.
